facts.value: The torch has one motion-state table entry, selected by state 0. Pickup always clears both item-command variables and invokes the model-flag setter, but enters state 0 and advances animation only when owner is non-null. The animation callback invokes the complementary model action at exactly frame 3.0 before testing removal. Owner absence or leaving ftGw_MS_AttackS4 invokes the destruction notifier and returns true; the notifier calls the fighter only for a non-null owner. While retained, the callback sets animation rate to 0.0 when the owner's smash_attrs.state equals 2 and to 1.0 otherwise, updating the JObj rate only when the stored value differs.
